home.title: My Reports
home.headerSubtitle: Track water quality reports you have submitted to DAWASA.
home.headerSubtitleNoPhone: Sign in to sync your reports and contact details.
home.emptyHint: Use the + button to report a water quality issue in your area.
home.emptyPhoneHint: Register or enter your account to see your reports here.
home.statsHint: Tap a report to view your photo, notes, and progress
home.cardHint: Opens report details with your photo and progress

messages.title: Contact DAWASA
messages.headerSubtitle: Your profile details are included with every message.
messages.profileRequired: Register or enter your account before sending a message.
messages.sendError: Could not send your message. It was saved and will retry when online.
messages.emptyHint: Send a message to DAWASA about your water quality concerns.

profile.title: Profile
profile.headerSubtitle: Manage your contact details and language preference.
profile.subtitle: Your details are included when you message DAWASA.
profile.saveFailed: Could not save your profile. Check your connection and try again.
profile.accountSectionHint: Name and contact details for your reports.
profile.locationSectionHint: Your area helps DAWASA route your report.
profile.basicInformationHint: Update your name, phone numbers, and email.
profile.basicInformationRowHint: Manage your name and contact details
profile.locationSectionRowHint: Set your area for report routing
profile.chooseLanguageHint: Select the language used across the app.
profile.settingsFootnote: Your details are included when you submit reports or message DAWASA.

auth.welcomeSubtitle: Report quality issues, track progress, and reach support, all from your phone.
auth.phoneSubtitle: We'll text you a 4-digit code to verify it's you.
auth.phoneHint: Tanzania mobile numbers starting with 06 or 07
auth.phonePrivacy: Your number is only used to verify your identity. We never share it with third parties.
auth.invalidPhone: Enter a valid Tanzania mobile number
auth.otpDevNotice: SMS is not connected yet. Your verification code is shown below until our SMS provider is integrated.
auth.otpDevTapHint: Tap the code to fill the boxes below
auth.otpExpired: Code expired. Request a new one.
auth.otpTooManyAttempts: Too many attempts. Request a new code.
auth.otpVerifyFailed: Could not verify the code. Try again.
auth.otpSendFailed: Could not send the code. Check your connection.
auth.otpCooldown: Please wait before requesting another code.
auth.otpSessionMissing: Session expired. Start again from your phone number.
auth.onboardingSubtitle: Tell us your name and preferred language.
auth.onboardingNameHint: Use your real name so DAWASA can identify your reports.
auth.onboardingPrivacy: Your name and language preference are saved to your account and used across the app.
auth.phoneAlreadyRegistered: This phone number is already registered.
auth.registerFailed: Could not create your account. Check your connection and try again.
auth.profileRequired: Sign in with your phone number to continue.
auth.signOutHint: Use a different phone number on this device.
auth.logoutConfirmTitle: Do you want to log out?

camera.title: Report Water Quality
camera.permissionDenied: Camera permission is required to report an issue.
camera.locationDenied: Location permission helps us find the issue area.
camera.locationRequired: GPS location is required before you can continue. Enable location and try again.
camera.photoFailed: Could not process the photo. Try again with a smaller image.

confirm.title: Confirm & Submit
confirm.offlineMessage: No connection. Your report will be sent automatically when you reconnect.
confirm.locationRequired: GPS coordinates are required to submit. Go back and retake the photo with location enabled.
confirm.areaManualPlaceholder: e.g. Kinondoni — helps if GPS is unavailable
confirm.imageLoadError: Could not load the photo. Please retake it.
confirm.submitError: Could not submit your report. Please try again.
confirm.queueFull: Offline queue is full. Please connect and try again.

submitted.title: Report Submitted
submitted.subtitle: Your report has been received and is being processed.

complaintDetail.title: Report details
complaintDetail.loadError: Could not load this report. Pull to refresh on Home and try again.
